text:
alex: rolling a slim-step traffic matrix for /v1/generate. plan: 20% -> 40% -> 60% -> 80% over four steps (4m each). change window: now. release tag v2.3.1-pin.
jen: ack. which router pool and region split?
alex: using pool-b as new backend in eu-west and us-west, pool-a is current. route will use path + cookie for sticky sessions. config snippet:
```
route:
  name: traffic-matrix-slimstep
  steps:
    - weight: 20
      duration: 240
    - weight: 40
      duration: 240
    - weight: 60
      duration: 240
    - weight: 80
      duration: 240
fallback: roll-to=pool-a
```
mike: request deploy-bot to start canary checks after step 1. also, keep an eye on queue depths.
deploy-bot: deploy started: release=v2.3.1-pin target=pools/pool-b started_by=alex id=deploy_2003123456
sre-oncall: dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/abc123/latency (p95 target < 450ms) & https://grafana.redwood.net/d/def456/errors (errors < 0.5%). will alert on breaches.
router-lead: keep session-affinity sticky for 30s to avoid duplicate context while warm caches populate.
jen: rollback criteria proposed: p95 > 600ms OR errors > 1% sustained for 2m OR customer 5xx spike. comfortable with those?
alex: yes. also pin model binary and dependencies for 24h. release notes: https://redwood.docs/releases/v2.3.1
deploy-bot: step 1 completed: weight=20% -> SUCCESS. metrics: p95=430ms, errors=0.2%, qdepth stable.
mike: starting step 2 -> 40%
deploy-bot: step 2 completed: weight=40% -> SUCCESS. metrics: p95=445ms, errors=0.25%
sre-oncall: saw a minor spike in eu-west (~t+7m): transient 503s from backend warmup. increased backend timeout and retried; errors back to baseline. logging: `backend-warmup-timeout` flagged.
alex: hold progression at 40% for an extra 4m to confirm warmup is solved.
jen: noted. tagging on-call to monitor for 15m :eyes:
router-lead: prewired fallback set: `routerctl set-route traffic-matrix-slimstep --fallback pool-a --mode immediate`
mike: abort command if needed: `deploy-bot rollback deploy_2003123456 --reason "latency/regression"`
deploy-bot: step 3 completed: weight=60% -> SUCCESS. metrics: p95=438ms, errors=0.22%
deploy-bot: final step completed: weight=80% -> SUCCESS. final metrics: p95=440ms, errors=0.2%. release marked active. changelog: https://redwood.docs/releases/v2.3.1#changes
alex: thanks all. if we need to revert we'll open a follow-up incident and run the rollback command. leaving monitoring on for 1h, then closing thread. :tada:
